Using the corrected odd-index term:
\[
a_{2k-1}=a_1+2(k-1)d
\]
so the odd-indexed sum is
\[
\sum_{k=1}^n a_{2k-1}=na_1+n(n-1)d=90.
\]
The even-indexed sum is
\[
\sum_{k=1}^n a_{2k}=na_1+n^2d=72.
\]
Subtracting gives
\[
-n d=18 \implies nd=-18.
\]
Also,
\[
a_1-a_{2n}=-(2n-1)d=33 \implies (2n-1)d=-33.
\]
Substitute \(d=-18/n\):
\[
(2n-1)\left(-\frac{18}{n}\right)=-33
\]
\[
18(2n-1)=33n
\]
\[
36n-18=33n \implies n=6.
\]
Thus
\[
d=-\frac{18}{6}=-3.
\]

\[
\boxed{-3}
\]
